description: Check current UK electricity carbon intensity. Returns gCO2/kWh (forecast and actual) plus intensity level (very low to very high). Use to schedule energy-intensive tasks during low-carbon periods.
name: get_intensity

actual_gco2_per_kwh.description: Actual carbon intensity in grams CO2 per kilowatt-hour, or null if not available

forecast_gco2_per_kwh.description: Forecasted carbon intensity in grams CO2 per kilowatt-hour

from.description: Start time of the intensity period (ISO 8601)

index.description: Intensity index level (e.g., very low, low, moderate, high, very high)

to.description: End time of the intensity period (ISO 8601)

title: Get Intensity
